We investigate how humans perceive and i.en: We investigate how humans perceive and integrate multimodal social cues to understand the cognitive mechanisms underlying social interaction. Inspired by these mechanisms, we develop computational models and embodied robotic systems to advance artificial social intelligence. Through human-robot interaction studies, we explore how people interact with intelligent agents, establishing a bidirectional link between human social cognition and embodied artificial intelligence.
We investigate how humans perceive and i.zh: 我们研究人类如何感知与整合多模态社会线索，以理解社会交互背后的认知机制。受这些机制启发，我们构建计算模型与具身机器人系统，推动人工社会智能的发展。通过人机交互研究，我们探索人们如何与智能体交互，在人类社会认知与具身人工智能之间建立双向联系。

We welcome researchers and students inte.en: We welcome researchers and students interested in social cognition, human-AI interaction and embodied AI. Contact us to discuss opportunities to work with SEIL Lab.
